name: Edge Filter
description: Gradient edge detectors in one effect: Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts cross and Scharr.

params.name: kind
params.description: Edge operator: 0 = sobel, 1 = prewitt, 2 = roberts, 3 = scharr

params.name: scale
params.description: Gain applied to the gradient magnitude

params.name: delta
params.description: Value added to the result, in 8-bit levels

params.name: luma
params.description: 1 = edges of the luma only, written to all three channels
